statements.status_notes: jackson-core 2.16.1 is bundled inside ray_dist.jar, which is part of the Ray Python package. The vulnerable async JSON parser in jackson-core is only reachable when Ray's Java-based distributed runtime processes JSON input. Airflow uses Ray exclusively as a Python client library via vertex_ray from google_cloud_aiplatform to manage remote Ray resources on Vertex AI. The Ray Java runtime is never started within the Airflow container, so the vulnerable async parser code path is never executed. Upstream Ray still pins jackson 2.16.1 in java/dependencies.bzl on master.

jackson-core 2.16.1 is bundled inside ray_dist.jar, which is part of the Ray Python package. The vulnerable async JSON parser in jackson-core is only reachable when Ray's Java-based distributed runtime processes JSON input. Airflow uses Ray exclusively as a Python client library via vertex_ray from google_cloud_aiplatform to manage remote Ray resources on Vertex AI. The Ray Java runtime is never started within the Airflow container, so the vulnerable async parser code path is never executed. Upstream Ray still pins jackson 2.16.1 in java/dependencies.bzl on master.

The jackson-core instances used by neo4j have been bumped to a fixed version. The remaining jackson-core instances are shaded and relocated inside parquet-jackson JARs. The parquet-jackson library does not use nor expose for use the vulnerable async parser (NonBlockingJsonParser and related classes).
